name: Converia
description_en:
Converia connects the academic and operational parts of a conference: submissions, reviews, programme planning, registration and invoices. Its emphasis is multi-day, content-driven meetings where an accepted contribution needs to become a session with a speaker, room and time. It also supports check-in, attendee information and reporting around that shared data.

The pricing model distinguishes an individual conference subscription from annual quotas spread across several events. Base subscription, ticket-revenue fee and payment processing are different charges. The website discusses research into AI-assisted planning; that must not be presented as a generally available automation feature.
description_zh:
Converia 连接会议的学术与运营部分，包括投稿、评审、议程规划、报名和发票，重点面向多日、内容驱动的专业会议，让录用稿件成为具备讲者、场地和时间的会议环节，并围绕同一数据支持签到、参与者信息和报表。

定价区分单一会议订阅与跨多个活动分配的年度额度。基础订阅、票款抽成及支付处理是不同费用。官网提到 AI 辅助规划研究，不能把它写成已普遍上线的自动化功能。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect, review and place accepted contributions into tracks, rooms and times.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集、评审并把录用内容安排到分轨、房间及时间。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage attendee records, ticket rules, invoices and check-in through shared data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 用共享数据管理报名者、票种规则、发票与签到。

en: Manage an academic contribution through review into a two-track programme.
zh: 把学术投稿经评审排入双分轨议程。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define submissions, review criteria, participant capacity and invoicing before configuring a sample conference.
steps.zh: 配置样例会议前明确投稿、评审标准、人数及发票要求。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual subscription and participant/presentation quotas, ticket share, payment processing and optional services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Pro Starter €49/month, Plus €149, Advanced €349 with annual contracts and net pricing. Ticket-revenue share 2.5/2.4/2.2%, cap €15/ticket. Flex XS €129/month, S €249, M €449 with annual pooled quotas; larger/custom quoted. Converia Pay and optional services/add-ons cost separately.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Pro Starter 每月 €49、Plus €149、Advanced €349，年度合同、未税。票款抽成 2.5/2.4/2.2%，每票上限 €15。Flex XS 每月 €129、S €249、M €449，共享年度额度；更大或定制询价。Converia Pay 及可选服务/附加项另计。

sources.title: Converia conference management software

sources.title: Abstracts, Review & Program Planning | Converia
sources.research_notes_en: Configurable submissions and blind review, accepted contribution scheduling, speaker conflicts and proceedings export.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Keep submission decisions connected to the programme
sections.title_zh: 让投稿决定与议程相连
sections.en: Authors submit through configurable forms with permitted file types and sizes. Reviewers use organizer-defined criteria; blind or double-blind review and workload assignment can be configured. Accepted contributions then enter tracks, rooms and times, with speaker-conflict checks. For an illustrative two-track meeting, test an edited title and a speaker appearing in two sessions, then inspect the published programme and proceedings rather than only the organizer view.
sections.zh: 作者通过配置好的表单提交，文件类型及大小可设。评审使用主办方标准，可以配置盲审、双盲和工作量分配；录用后进入分轨、房间与时间，并检查讲者冲突。例如两分轨会议，应测试标题修改及同一讲者出现两次，再核对公开议程和会议文集，不能只看后台。

sections.title_en: Choose one-conference or pooled annual capacity
sections.title_zh: 选择单会议或年度共享容量
sections.en: Pro is a monthly-priced subscription with an annual contract: Starter €49 for up to 150 participants, Plus €149 for up to 300, and Advanced €349 for up to 750. Limits and feature levels differ. Flex distributes annual participant and presentation quotas across events; XS starts €129/month for 500 participants and 100 presentations yearly, S €249 and M €449. Do not interpret a monthly headline as a one-month commitment.
sections.zh: Pro 按月标价但为年度合同：Starter €49、最多 150 人，Plus €149、最多 300 人，Advanced €349、最多 750 人，容量与功能不同。Flex 把年度参与者和报告额度跨活动分配，XS 每月 €129、年度 500 人和 100 份报告，S €249，M €449。不能把月度标价当作仅承诺一个月。

sections.title_en: Separate ticket fees from payment processing
sections.title_zh: 区分票款抽成与支付处理费
sections.en: The page lists net prices plus ticket-revenue shares of 2.5%, 2.4% or 2.2%, capped at €15 per ticket, with no such fee for free registrations. Converia Pay is separate: 2.95% for bank transfer and 3.45% for card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. An own payment account is described as possible. Participant overages, website/app/domain add-ons and booked support can add cost. For a €100 paid ticket on a 2.5% plan, the €2.50 platform share is not the entire payment cost.
sections.zh: 页面价格未税，票款抽成为 2.5%、2.4% 或 2.2%，每票上限 €15，免费报名不收此项。Converia Pay 另计，银行转账 2.95%，银行卡、Apple Pay 或 Google Pay 为 3.45%；也可使用自己的收款账户。人数超额、网站/应用/域名及预约支持可能另费。例如 €100 门票在 2.5% 套餐的平台抽成为 €2.50，但不是全部支付成本。

sections.en: The service targets universities, societies and professional conference organizers. A simple networking meetup may not need its submission and programme workflow. Before launch, test reviewer conflicts, registration eligibility, invoice correction and check-in against the same person record. EU hosting is advertised, but exact contractual retention and recovery were not verified. No source-code license or self-hosted package was established, and no live conference flow was executed.
sections.zh: 产品面向大学、学会及专业会议组织者，简单交流聚会未必需要投稿和议程流程。上线前应针对同一人员记录测试评审冲突、报名资格、发票更正和签到。官网宣传欧盟托管，但准确合同保留与恢复未核实，也未确认源码许可或自托管服务包，本文未执行真实会议流程。

research_gaps: No submission, double-blind configuration, scheduling, payment, invoice, check-in or export was executed.
Exact quota units, taxes, add-ons, payment settlement/refunds, residency/retention, source license and self-hosting require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
